text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With summer camp nearly over, Agnes Digital
was training more desperately than ever before.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant* I'm melting~. I feel like I'm turning into
some kind of gel and becoming one with the earth~.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I ran until I hit my absolute limit~.
Now I can finally face Opera O-san, Doto-san,
and my juniors...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: "To be honest, I'm nothing but nervous! Especially since Opera O-san and Doto-san are so strong!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
“I'm an all-rounder, though.
I'll gather as much experience as I can, and after that...”

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
We'll overwhelm them with sheer versatility!
That's our only option!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even if the wall before her was dauntingly high,
Agnes Digital felt no hesitation.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: That night—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
“—I see. So these are the contenders
predicted for the Tenno Sho (Autumn)...”

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: In that case, based on ability—it's a contest between the three of them.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Eh? Three people? Shakur-san,
pardon me for asking out of the blue, but...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
That makes four of us, right? Opera O-san,
Doto-san, me, and...
the girl who won the NHK Mile Cup...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Don't tell me, am I being underrated?
Like, the weakest of the Four Heavenly Kings?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
That's not it. About that Umamusume
who won the NHK Mile Cup, though...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"She probably won't make the cut.
She won't be able to secure a starting gate."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Huh... We can't get an entry slot...?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Yeah, there are more registered runners than available spots, after all.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
As things stand now, unless someone drops out,
it's practically impossible.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Her talent might be top-notch. The news might be buzzing
about a new generation's hope and the underdog taking over, but...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
You can't argue with numbers.
That's just reality.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
She... couldn't enter...
Because of the gate limits...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Digital hung her head in dejection
on the beach at night...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Trainer, can you believe this is actually happening?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"She's burning with hope, you see!
Right now is her peak growth period, you see!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"And yet, not being able to run...
The Goddess of Fate really takes her pranks too far, doesn't she?"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Well, the Twinkle Series is harsh.
You win some, you lose some, and tears are unavoidable.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
But, beyond the tears, true emotion always awaits!
That's why we can clash fair and square!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
But... not even being able to run is just too sad,
don't you think?
There's nothing waiting past those tears...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
As an Umamusume-chan devotee, this is truly...
unforgivable... Kuuuugh...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
If my entering means... I'm nipping
that girl's dream in the bud...
choice_data_list: You're not going to say you're withdrawing, are you?
You're not going to withdraw, are you?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
T-That's... Because running alongside
Opera O-san and Doto-san
was my dream too.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Still, going out there as I am now, I don't feel like I can win.
Not when I'm feeling like this...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: There's just... no way I could win, is there...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: How... am I supposed to take this...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even if it's not about herself, Agnes Digital
takes it all to heart as if it were her own.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Because I love every single Umamusume.
The tragic fates of young Umamusume clung to my feet like tangled weeds.
